title: ProjectRegistry
description: Local project registry (`registry.json`): project IDs mapped to local paths.

items.title: ProjectRegistration
items.description: One registered project: its stable ID and where it lives on this machine.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

path.title: AbsolutePath
path.description: Current checkout path on the coordinator machine.

registered_at.title: Timestamp
registered_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

updated_at.title: Timestamp
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

previous_paths.description: Earlier checkout paths, oldest first, kept when a project is remapped.

items.title: AbsolutePath
items.description: Absolute, machine-specific filesystem path. Only the local registry stores these.
